items.title: Investing in the game: how athletes are turning personal brand into sports equity - LawInSport
items.raw_summary: In a previous article[1], we explored how a new generation of athletes are approaching personal branding as a professional discipline, registering trademarks for names and celebrations to build commercial platforms designed to outlast their playing careers. That strategy reflects a wider recognition among athletes that their identity, exposure and experience in sport constitute a commercial asset in their own right. However, brand protection is only one way in which athletes can leverage their success. Savvy athletes are now using their platforms and connections to secure deal access,[2] guide their investment strategies in private sport assets, and generate long-term returns independent of sporting performance. David Beckham’s DB Ventures is perhaps the paradigm of this approach: a platform that has systematically converted personal brand equity into a portfolio of private sports investments[3], spanning club ownership, media, hospitality and lifestyle businesses. LeBron James has followed a similar trajectory through his SpringHill Company and strategic equity positions.[4] The direction of travel is clear: athletes are no longer simply the product around which commercial value is built. They are becoming the investors, the equity holders and the strategic partners shaping the sports industry

items.title: Kering perde fôlego e vê vendas pressionadas em mercado de luxo ainda fraco no 3º tri
items.raw_summary: A Kering afirmou, em balanço divulgado na quinta-feira, 22, que suas vendas foram impactadas por um mercado de luxo desafiador no trimestre mais recente, enquanto o grupo parisiense busca recuperar o ritmo de suas marcas. A dona de Gucci, Bottega Veneta e outras grifes de alto padrão registrou queda de 1% na receita, em base […] O post Kering perde fôlego e vê vendas pressionadas em mercado de luxo ainda fraco no 3º tri apareceu primeiro em Mercado&Consumo .
items.summary_pt: Grupo de luxo registra queda de vendas (1%) em mercado desafiador; até grandes marcas enfrentam pressão.
items.pme_pt: Reforça que tamanho não protege marca fraca; posicionamento claro e diferenciado é necessário até para líderes de mercado.
